summary: ATTENTION INVESTERS. Available to purchase with a tenant in situ on an assured shorthold tenancy, with a gross yield in the region of 8%, a recently modernised, end terraced, double fronted 2 bedroom home, in this popular area, close to the town centre and university.
description:
An excellent addition to any investment portfolio, or an ideal first buy-to-let opportunity, 1 Fusehill Street is an attractive and well-presented end-terrace property offered with reliable tenants in situ. Currently achieving £650 per calendar month, the tenants have expressed a clear intention to remain, providing immediate and ongoing rental income.

The property has been thoughtfully improved in recent years and offers a well-proportioned and flexible layout. The ground floor comprises a welcoming central hallway, a spacious kitchen dining room, and a dual-aspect living room featuring a charming wood-burning stove. To the first floor are two bedrooms and a well-appointed bathroom.

Externally, there is a small enclosed rear yard with pedestrian access.

Ideally located for investment purposes, the property is within easy reach of the University of Cumbria and is less than a five-minute walk from Botchergate and Carlisle city centre.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the opportunity on offer.

Directions From the city centre head through Portland Square onto Aglionby Street. Turn right onto Myddleton Street which becomes Fusehill Street.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
